basic_info.description: A jewel-box home in Russian Hill's iconic Bellaire Tower, #902 offers stunning views of San Francisco's landmarks and a sophisticated blend of charming architecture and modern design. The living room, at the southeast corner, is bathed in morning light, highlighting Coit Tower, the Downtown skyline, and Nob Hill's architecture. The kitchen features top-of-the-line materials and appliances, including custom Leicht Orlando cabinetry, Miele cooktop, Sub-Zero refrigerator, and Futura Plus dishwasher. Artemide light fixtures complement the clean lines, with archways and moldings reflecting Bellaire Tower's 1930 Art Deco heritage. The 930 sq. ft. layout (approx.) maximizes space with five closets and an adjacent flexible area for a home office or large closet. The spacious bedroom enjoys eastern skyline views and a walk-in closet. The bath, clad in honed Calacatta gold marble, features a Wet Style sink, Robern medicine cabinet, Dornbracht fixtures, and Miele laundry appliances. Valet parking and storage complete the residence. Bellaire Tower, designed by H.C. Baumann, is a Russian Hill icon with its Art Deco facade and ornate lobby. The area's Hyde Street and Polk Corridor offer some of San Francisco's best shopping and dining.
